bundle.shortDescription: A desktop pet that reads your Todoist tasks.
bundle.longDescription: TodoPet lives on top of your taskbar, reads your Todoist tasks, asks you to plan three tasks a day, reminds you at good moments and gets happy or grumpy with your progress.
